My dad- late 60s. Prob around 280-300. Has an internal pacemaker and high blood pressure. He bikes for 3 hours each and every morning, but again refuses to give up "the good stuff". My brother- 28. Reasonably successful. Has always been the skinny one. Depressive personality (legit and diagnosed depressive). Still cares for himself, stays active and eats in moderation. Doesn't go to the gym.
